mbean.description: Reports slow and failed queries through JMX and publishes the statistics of the pool that registered it
mbean.name: SlowQueryReportJmx

attribute.description: The name of the connection pool this Jmx bean is representing
attribute.name: PoolName

attribute.description: Names of the pools that currently publish recorded statistics in this JVM
attribute.name: PoolNames

attribute.description: All the recorded query stats, as one CompositeData per recorded query
attribute.name: SlowQueriesCD

notification.description: Notification sent out by the slow query report when a query exceeds the threshold
notification.name: SLOW QUERY

notification.description: Notification sent out by the slow query report when a query fails execution
notification.name: FAILED QUERY
